title: Cosmopsychism is the parallel of pantheism, not of polytheism

statements.text: Panpsychism says phenomenality is everywhere because everything in the cosmos is phenomenal, which parallels an extreme polytheism. Pantheism says divinity is everywhere because the cosmos as a whole is divine, and replacing divinity with phenomenality yields cosmopsychism: phenomenality is everywhere because the cosmos as a whole is phenomenal.

sources.quote: if we replace divinity with phenomenality in pantheism we can derive cosmopsychism
